g.text: Coupled candidate selection for adaptive B-spline fitting
Ordered samples → dense candidates → one adaptive mask → coupled refinement → one final refit
Rank once; build one discrete mask
One network forward; no greedy search
Try masks / geometry; evaluate actual B-spline fits
Fit / peak error + keep / count / geometry
